name: Explorers Camp
description_short: YMCA day camp for children entering grades 2 to 5, based at Camden-Rockport Middle School, 9 am to 4 pm. Each week has a new theme and three field trips, plus field games, crafts, nature hikes, STEM projects and canoeing.
notes: Non-member rate $282 a week; Penobscot Bay YMCA members pay $232. Before care 7:30 to 9 am and after care 4 to 5:30 pm at the school, $40 a week each.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Explorers Camp page: entering grades 2 to 5, home base Camden-Rockport Middle School, 9 am to 4 pm, eight weeks, members $232 and non-members $282 a week, before and after care $40 a week each, financial assistance. Ages derived from grades 2 to 5. City and ZIP are the YMCA's own address on the page (116 Union Street, PO Box 840, Rockport, ME 04856); the page does not give the school's address.

warnings: Field trip bus runs during camp, but there is no bus to or from camp, so transportation is left unset.
unknowns: Street address and town of Camden-Rockport Middle School

for_andrew: The page names the camp's home base, Camden-Rockport Middle School, but not its address or town. City and ZIP are the YMCA's own address (Rockport 04856). The 2026 brochure PDF is over the fetcher's 8 MB cap and was not read. Keep Rockport, or does the school's town need confirming?
Rockport is not in cities.py, so the draft fails validation until it is added from the Census gazetteer.
The same Y runs Camp Wonder (Thomaston), Discovery Camp and Adventure Camp on their own pages; only Explorers Camp is drafted here.
